title: UN: At Least 372 Ukrainian Civilians Killed in October; Glide-Bomb Deaths Doubled
detail: A UN report cited in news coverage says Russia's war killed at least 372 Ukrainian civilians in October, with deaths from glide bombs doubling over a month. Only the headline was available; the outlet and full breakdown were not verified.

title: Kyiv Urges Trump and Xi to Pressure Putin as Moscow Reaches Military Deal with Beijing
detail: Kyiv called on Trump and Xi to pressure Putin, as reports said Moscow reached a military agreement with Beijing. Only the headline was available; terms of the deal are not established.
